name: Aliens versus Predator 2
verified: 2026-10-14, latte-lab, Wine 11.0: installed from the two discs without the InstallShield setup; the intro films play
notes: The discs' own setup is a 16/32-bit InstallShield 6 that wants DCOM95; its cabinets are read directly instead. DirectX on disc 2 is not needed: Wine has it. GameSpy Arcade is gone from the internet; LAN play needs the network turned on.
